fixes.explanation: Prayer never comes up here, baker. Eliphaz asks, “Do you listen in on the council of God or limit wisdom to yourself?” (Job 15:8). He's asking whether Job is sitting on some secret wisdom the rest of them missed, like a guy who walks into the meeting and acts like he read a memo nobody else got. Then comes the follow-up: “What do you know that we do not?” (Job 15:9). It's about who knows what, not about how often anybody prays.

It's true, friend. Eliphaz says the wicked man is “…rushing headlong at Him with a thick, studded shield.” (Job 15:26). Look at the picture he paints: a man charging full speed at the Almighty, with his shield out in front like that will help. I think the shield is the funny part, because who brings a shield to run at God? Eliphaz says it right there in the verse, so this one is true.
